user.title: Ring account
user.description: Log in to the Ring account that owns the Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam. This creates a separate Ring session, so the Ring integration stays logged in.

2fa.title: Two-factor authentication
2fa.description: Enter the code Ring sent you.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Ring again
reauth_confirm.description: The Ring login for {username} has expired.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Ring. Ring briefly refuses logins after many attempts (HTTP 406); wait a while and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Ring account is already set up.
abort.no_devices: No Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam found on this Ring account.

step.name: Step
step.description: Move one step (about 16° pan or 10° tilt).

move.name: Move
move.description: Start moving continuously, or keep an ongoing move going. It stops after the duration unless called again, or on Stop.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Motor speed (0.5 ≈ 34°/s; below about 0.4 it doesn't move).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Stop automatically after this many seconds.

home.name: Home position
home.description: Go to the Home Position set in the Ring app.

prepare.name: Prepare
prepare.description: Open a Ring session now so the next command is instant (the pad card calls this on press).

set_position.name: Set position
set_position.description: Point the camera at exact pan/tilt angles.
